source_note: FY2025 unit-economics decomposition: RASK = passenger revenue / ASK; CASK = operating cost / ASK; component CASK from official driver layer or annual-report cost table.  Other = operating cost minus disclosed components (includes CAAC fund, distribution, unallocated; for partial-coverage companies 'other' also absorbs the undisclosed aircraft/airport/maintenance components).  Research decomposition, not a forecast.
